payload.title: The auditors could not give an opinion on the 2024/25 accounts
payload.summary: Ernst & Young disclaimed its opinion on the 2024/25 accounts. That sounds alarming and needs its context: the government set national "backstop" dates to clear a countrywide audit backlog, and thousands of council-years across England were disclaimed the same way. It is not a finding that Norwich's numbers are wrong. It does mean that for four years running nobody independently verified them.
detail: The auditor's separate value-for-money work has reported weaknesses in governance and in financial reporting, and none against financial sustainability.
The governance weakness concerns oversight of the council's own companies, after the wind-up of its housing company Lion Homes.
